voxceleb1.vox1_o_10spk_subset_note: VoxCeleb1-O 10-speaker subset: official veri_test2.txt filtered to trials whose enrollment AND test speakers are both among the 10 held-out eval speakers, capped at 2,500 trials (~72% target). NOT comparable to published VoxCeleb1-O numbers; 30/40 official test speakers are used for training by vox_* and univ_* models.
